searchText: I can update 5820 to also remove the envelope signature. And will open PRs for relevant APIs yeah not signing the payload sounds great. we are okay with this being late in the process given that glamsterdam is not happening before january cc <@554799849288105986> We can also sell this as a PQ-friendly change. It's unfortunate we didn't consider this earlier. why is this PQ friendly?> it only becomes friendly if we remove the signature from the bid, which we can't One fewer signature the signature is presumably cheaper to verify than the HTR and it doesn't go in blocks but on one side we have a signature verification + RLP, on the other only an HTR. and seems like the HTR is more or less similar computation as RLP. correct? but unless GLOAS will be delayed due to 8037, adopting 5820 seems a stretch. On the other hand, if we will adopt it in next fork, there will be some additional complexity to maintain (we need to have both implementation, also considering backfilling) I'm conflicted. I'm kind of leaning to, if we want 5820, do it now, otherwise don't try to adopt it in future forks Updated the specs to add parent_payload_root to the bid, remove the envelope signature. Also API PRs here: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/677 https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/176 i'm working on 5820 in lighthouse now feel like clients should bang out implementations if they have the resources I already have some evaluation done. If we have some rough consensus in adopting it I can translate it into a PR. Got an early docker image to test against. Includes the API changes. `chainsafe/lodestar:payload-root-unsigned-envelope`
